name: agent-acp
title: AI Agent (ACP)
description: Chat with Claude, Codex (ChatGPT) or any ACP agent through the Agent Client Protocol, the same way Zed does. Uses your existing logins, no API key required.
author: daniele

commands.name: ask-agent
commands.title: Ask AI Agent
commands.description: Chat with your ACP agent, with follow-ups

commands.name: run-prompt
commands.title: Run Prompt
commands.description: Run a saved prompt on the selected text or clipboard

commands.name: manage-prompts
commands.title: Manage Prompts
commands.description: Create and edit prompts with {selection} and {clipboard} variables

commands.name: summarize-page
commands.title: Summarize Webpage
commands.description: Summarize the active browser tab (needs the Raycast Browser Extension)

commands.name: summarize-selection
commands.title: Summarize Selected Text
commands.description: Summarize the text selected in the frontmost app

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Grammar of Selected Text
commands.description: Fix spelling and grammar of the selected text

commands.name: explain-selection
commands.title: Explain Selected Text
commands.description: Explain the selected text or code

preferences.name: agent
preferences.title: Agent
preferences.description: Which ACP agent to run. Claude uses your Claude Code login; Codex uses your ChatGPT login (run `codex login` once).

preferences.name: agentCommand
preferences.title: Agent Command
preferences.description: Only used when Agent is 'Custom command' (e.g. `gemini --experimental-acp`, or a globally installed `claude-agent-acp` for faster startup).

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Extra PATH
preferences.description: Colon-separated folders added to PATH so node/npx and the agent are found (Raycast doesn't load your shell profile).

preferences.name: workingDirectory
preferences.title: Working Directory
preferences.description: Folder the agent works in (absolute path). Defaults to your home folder.

preferences.name: permissionPolicy
preferences.title: Tool Permissions
preferences.description: What to do when the agent wants to run a tool (edit files, run commands…)

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key (optional)
preferences.description: Only needed if you're not logged in. Passed as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Claude) or OPENAI_API_KEY (Codex).

preferences.name: autoAttachSelection
preferences.title: Chat
preferences.label: Attach selected text automatically when opening Ask AI Agent
preferences.description: When on, text selected in the frontmost app is attached to your first question.
